description: This file defines a React component named DocBreadcrumbs used to render breadcrumb navigation in a documentation website. It utilizes Docusaurus theme hooks to obtain breadcrumb data and build the breadcrumb trail, including a home icon link. The file also includes auxiliary components for individual breadcrumb items and links.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsItemLink
classes.description: Component rendering a breadcrumb link, which is a <Link> if href is provided, or a <span> otherwise.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsItem
classes.description: Component rendering an individual breadcrumb item, with optional active state styling.

classes.name: HomeBreadcrumbItem
classes.description: Component rendering the home breadcrumb item, linking to the '/docs' page.

methods.name: DocBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Main React component that renders the full breadcrumb navigation based on sidebar breadcrumbs and home page route.
